get.description: The process is up. It touches nothing: no database, no provider.
The process is up. It touches nothing: no database, no provider.

Ready to serve: not shutting down and, with PostgreSQL, the database answers a minimal
query. A status word only; never a host, a role, a version or a setting.

post.description:
One conversational turn. Idempotent per `client_turn_id` while the API process retains
the conversation. The assistant can only read and prepare a review; it cannot book.

409.description: idempotency_key_reused, turn_in_progress, conversation_busy, turn_out_of_order or conversation_limit_reached. Nothing was accepted. `turn_in_progress` and `conversation_busy` send Retry-After.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (turn_in_progress, busy).

503.description: agent_unavailable (no provider is configured), demo_budget_reached (today's allowance is used up), budget_unavailable (the budget could not be checked) or service_draining (the process is shutting down). The provider was not called.

post.description: Describe what booking this slot would do. Nothing is saved.
The only write. Requires a valid proposal token and an explicit `confirm: true`.

200.description: The proposal had already been confirmed: the original appointment.

409.description: slot_unavailable (just taken), proposal_stale (details changed) or proposal_discarded (the visitor withdrew this review: nothing is booked).

422.description: validation_error, proposal_invalid, proposal_expired, or slot_not_offered (the time is no longer offered, for example it is now inside the lead time).

parameters.description: Local date in the business timezone (YYYY-MM-DD).
parameters.name: date

schema.description: Local date in the business timezone (YYYY-MM-DD).
schema.title: Date

422.description: Invalid request or date outside the window.

post.description: Transcribe one short recording. It does not call the assistant and stores nothing.

parameters.description: What the client says the recording lasts. Not verified by the server: diagnostics only.
parameters.name: X-Audio-Duration-Ms

schema.description: What the client says the recording lasts. Not verified by the server: diagnostics only.
schema.title: X-Audio-Duration-Ms

requestBody.description: The raw audio bytes of one short recording (at most 256 KB).

415.description: audio_unsupported: type not allowed, or the signature does not match it.

429.description: speech_busy: every transcription slot is taken.

503.description: speech_unavailable (no provider is configured), demo_budget_reached, budget_unavailable or service_draining. The provider was not called.
